'''Neska''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Haurgab]].

==History==
Founded on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Haurgab]], the [[City/Legends|city]] of Neska was thriving during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. When the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] arrived on the planet during the height of the war, the Republic troops were given permission to establish a small operations base near the city limits; the base would support the main planetary defense force stationed at [[Hadde Base]].<ref name="O66" />
